answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make each identity ride a comet of sequential attestations that no hollow clone can fake. Every peer must solve a fresh cipher bound to its private key before admission. A flood of puppets fails because each needs its own comet and cipher, burning compute and stake per identity. The per-clone cost now exceeds any reward, so mass registration collapses, while honest agents, already proven, keep their standing at no extra charge.
